Friends of the Manchester Animal Shelter (FMAS) is a non-profit, NO KILL shelter and pet resource center. We believe that all animals are deserving of life, respect and care. We provide medical care, spay/neuter, vaccinations, and daily care to over 1,500 abused, abandoned and homeless Manchester animals each year, and also aid thousands of pets and their families each year through our free and low-cost spay/neuter programs, community resources, and pet food pantry. 

Over the past 20 years FMAS has provided care and found loving homes for over 20,000 animals. 

Visit us at 490 Dunbarton Rd in Manchester, NH or on the web at www.manchesteranimalshelter.org.
